title: Blackberry Sorbet
changes_from_base: Seedless blackberry purée and a plain syrup with lemon replace the mango; no corn syrup.
summary: A deep purple sorbet of ripe blackberries, milled free of seeds and sharpened with lemon.
equipment: food mill with fine disc or fine sieve

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Bring the sugar and water to the boil, stirring until no sugar grains are left, then cool and refrigerate. Purée: pass the blackberries through the food mill, or blend them briefly and press through the sieve, to leave the hard seeds behind.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the cold syrup, lemon juice and salt into the purée, taste and add a little more lemon if needed. Chill until cold.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, then pack into the container and freeze for about 2 h.

tips: Late-summer wild or garden blackberries have the best flavour.
Frozen blackberries are fine; thaw them in a sieve over a bowl and keep the juice.
Taste the base cold and adjust the lemon before churning.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
